translations.english: Radiating like the rising sun, adorned with polished gold ornaments, wearing red coloured clothes, with beautiful black hair, wearing fresh flowers, being in the same young form as before, blameless Vaidehi was held in the arms of the fire god and presented to Rama.
translations.hindi: हे महाभाग कुबेर के छोटे भाई! हे जगद्विख्यात ! जब तुम क्रोध करते थे, तब इन्द्र भो तुम्हारे सामने खडे नहीं रह सकते थे
